_note: 學習路徑內容建置第9批 #5／6：that 子句當主詞／虛主詞 it（eng.t_adv.nouncl.that-subject，學測級／高階）。that ＋ 子句可以當整句的主詞（That he passed surprised everyone）；英語通常用虛主詞 It 開頭、把 that 子句移到句尾：It surprised everyone that he passed。常見框架＝It ＋ be ＋ 形容詞/名詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句（It is obvious that…／It is a fact that…）。高階特別防第二正解：用結構誘答（虛主詞該用 It 不用 There/That、連接詞該用 that 不用 what/which、語序）鎖唯一正解，不考可省略 that 的口語兩可情形。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix ncs_）。

units.title_zh: that 子句當主詞／虛主詞 it（It is obvious that…）
units.can_do: 我能用 that 子句當整句的主詞，並知道英語通常用虛主詞 It 開頭、把 that 子句移到後面，框架是 It ＋ be ＋ 形容詞/名詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句（It is obvious that…／It is true that…），連接詞用 that。
units.situation_group: 名詞子句 The that-clause as subject
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A that-clause can act as the subject of a sentence: 'That she won the prize is wonderful news' (the whole clause 'That she won the prize' is the subject).
claims.verification_ref: that 子句可當整句主詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: English usually uses the dummy subject 'It' and moves the that-clause to the end: 'It is wonderful news that she won the prize'; the 'It' stands in for the real subject (the that-clause).
claims.verification_ref: 英語常用虛主詞 It、把 that 子句移句尾；It 代替真正主詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The common pattern is 'It + be + adjective/noun + that + clause': 'It is obvious that everyone enjoys the game', 'It is a fact that the sun rises in the east'.
claims.verification_ref: 框架 It＋be＋adj/noun＋that＋子句；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The connector that introduces the clause in this pattern; use 'that' (not 'what' or 'which') to link the clause: 'It is clear that she is right'.
claims.verification_ref: 連接詞用 that（非 what/which）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A 'that' + full sentence can work together as the subject: That the team won made the whole town happy. Here 'That the team won' is the subject of the sentence. But starting this way makes the sentence top-heavy, so English usually prefers a dummy subject.
teach.zh_hint: that ＋ 一個完整句子，可以整組當「主詞」：That the team won made the whole town happy（球隊贏了這件事讓全鎮開心）。這裡 That the team won 就是整句的主詞。但這樣開頭句子頭太重，英語更常用虛主詞。

teach.body: It surprised everyone that he finished the race first.
teach.zh_hint: 他第一個跑完全程這件事讓大家很驚訝。虛主詞 It 開頭，真正的主詞是後面的 that he finished the race first。

teach.body: The common pattern is 'It + be + adjective/noun + that + clause': It is obvious that everyone enjoys the game; It is a fact that the sun rises in the east. The connector is 'that', not 'what' or 'which'.
teach.zh_hint: 常見框架＝It ＋ be 動詞 ＋ 形容詞／名詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句：It is obvious that everyone enjoys the game（每個人都很享受這個遊戲，這很明顯）、It is a fact that the sun rises in the east（太陽從東邊升起是事實）。連接詞用 that，不用 what 或 which。

teach.body: It is clear that hard work leads to success.
teach.zh_hint: 努力會帶來成功，這很清楚。It＋is＋clear＋that＋子句。

teach.body: Remember: the dummy subject is 'It' (not 'There', and not 'That' followed by another 'that'); the real subject is the that-clause at the end; the connector is always 'that'. Once you see which whole that-clause the 'It' stands for, you will not be confused by 'There is' or 'That is'.
teach.zh_hint: 記住：虛主詞用 It（不是 There、不是 That 開頭再接 that）；真正的主詞是後面的 that 子句；連接詞固定用 that。先看懂『It 代替的是哪一整個 that 子句』，就不會被 There is／That is 混淆。

teach.body: It is true that honesty is the best policy.
teach.zh_hint: 誠實是上策，這是真的。It is true that…；It 代替 that honesty is the best policy。

practice.stem: 選出正確的開頭：____ is surprising that she passed the exam without studying.（她沒讀書就通過考試，很令人驚訝）

distractor_rationales.That: That is surprising that… 會出現兩個 that、不成句；虛主詞開頭用 It。
distractor_rationales.There: There is… 是『有…存在』的句型，不帶 that 子句當真正主詞；這裡用虛主詞 It。
distractor_rationales.This: This 不當虛主詞代替後面的 that 子句；用 It。

practice.feedback: 虛主詞用 It：It is surprising that she passed the exam without studying。

practice.stem: 填入正確的連接詞：It is strange ____ no one noticed the mistake.（沒有人注意到這個錯誤，很奇怪）

distractor_rationales.what: what 用在『不知道的事物』的名詞子句（I don't know what he wants）；這裡引導完整子句用 that。
distractor_rationales.which: which 用來指前面提過的事物（關係子句）；引導這個名詞子句用 that。
distractor_rationales.it: it 不是連接詞；引導 that 子句的連接詞是 that。

practice.feedback: 引導名詞子句的連接詞用 that：It is strange that no one noticed the mistake。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句正確地用虛主詞 It 把 that 子句移到後面？
practice.answer: It is clear that she is right.
options: It is clear that she is right.
It is clear she is that right.
That is clear it she is right.
Is clear that it she is right.

that 位置錯了；that 要放在子句最前面引導整個子句：that she is right。
語序亂、虛主詞應是 It 不是 That；正確是 It is clear that she is right。
缺主詞又語序錯；正確開頭是虛主詞 It：It is clear that…。

practice.feedback: It ＋ be ＋ 形容詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句：It is clear that she is right。

practice.stem: 在 'That the team won made the whole town happy' 裡，'That the team won' 在句子裡當什麼？

distractor_rationales.受詞: 它在動詞 made 前面，是『做出讓全鎮開心這個動作』的主體＝主詞，不是受詞。
distractor_rationales.補語: 補語會放在 be 動詞等後面說明主詞；這裡它在句首當主詞。
distractor_rationales.副詞: 它不是修飾動作的副詞；它是整句的主詞（that 子句當主詞）。

practice.feedback: That the team won（球隊贏了這件事）是整句的主詞。

practice.stem: 在 'It is a fact that the sun rises in the east' 裡，開頭的 It ____。
practice.answer: 代替後面那個真正的主詞子句（虛主詞）
options: 代替後面那個真正的主詞子句（虛主詞）
指天空中的太陽那個天體
指句子發生的某個地方
當動詞 rises 的受詞

distractor_rationales.指天空中的太陽那個天體: It 不是指太陽那個天體；它是虛主詞，代替後面整個 that 子句。
distractor_rationales.指句子發生的某個地方: It 不是指地方；它是虛主詞，代替後面那個 that 子句。
distractor_rationales.當動詞 rises 的受詞: It 在句首當（虛）主詞，不是受詞。

practice.feedback: It 是虛主詞，代替真正的主詞 that the sun rises in the east。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: It is important that we tell the truth, and it is clear that honesty matters.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：兩個虛主詞句 It is important that… 和 it is clear that… 有沒有寫對、連接詞 that 有沒有漏，we tell the truth／honesty matters 有沒有寫對，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。虛主詞 It is… 輕讀帶出，that 子句稍放慢把重點說清楚，句尾下收。
